judged_text: Admin::EmbeddingController#update renders the serialized embedding without applying any request params — the OpenStruct embedding has no editable fields — and no template in the diff invokes the frontend saveChanges action, so the PUT /admin/customize/embedding route and the admin-embedding.js saveChanges/update({}) path are implementation work traceable to no requirement. Any client that PUTs /admin/customize/embedding receives a 200 success for a request that persisted nothing, and a future contributor who wires a save button to the existing saveChanges action ships a control that silently does nothing.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the fetched OpenStruct embedding (id + `embeddable_hosts`) without reading/applying any params, so a `PUT /admin/customize/embedding` will succeed while persisting nothing (`app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`). The frontend controller has a `saveChanges()` action that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})` (`admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6`), but the new `embedding.hbs` template contains no control that triggers `saveChanges` (only addHost/deleteHost). This is diff-grounded as potentially misleading/dead implementation rather than a currently user-visible broken behavior.
